shushu.description: Witch Task is a gamified productivity manager where users play as a witch running a potion business in a town filled with charming creatures. Each day, the town's inhabitants send potion orders that correspond to real-life tasks users need to complete. Built for anxious, creative students who struggle to stick with traditional productivity apps!

ghost.description: 1:AM Train is a cozy VR space where users board as a ghost and travel through space, with interactive stations designed for relaxation, mindfulness, and reflection. The origin, Midnight Train, is a website designed to improve mood and wellbeing, offering the same journey through the browser.

zero.description: An interactive 3D plaza scene featuring wandering characters, a subway system, and dynamic time-of-day lighting. Built with Three.js and featuring custom character behaviors and animations.

blender.description: Gallery showing my Blender work throughout the years!

vivi.description: GOGO TENNIS is a multiplayer fitness app that brings tennis home using devices you already own. One computer acts as a local network host, two smartphones serve as racket controllers, and Unity Netcode handles multiplayer communication. Real-time swing tracking via phone gyroscopes translates physical movement into precise in-game control.
